notes.title: The Un-BEATable Game... is Delayed
notes.content:
Progress is going well, it has just happened that the scope of the game and its complexity is bigger than I had anticipated. Creating the most revolutionary game ever made is hard work after all. My goal is to make the game and its concept justice so that when you inevitably actually buy the game and play it, It will be so hard that it will make a game reviewer want to cry. 

There is no planned release date at this moment. However, I can assure you that it will come in the next decade. I will be sure to inform you immediately when I actually know when the game is close to completion.

Thanks so much for sticking with this project!

Can you beat it?
- Vittorio Corbo

notes.title: Attempting to beat The Un-BEATable Game Demo
notes.content: In this stream Vittorio Corbo will chat about the development behind the game, talking about the game design and answering questions as showcases the game.

notes.title: Trying to bEAT the Un-BEATable demo with Vittorio Corbo
notes.content:
Can you beat it? This is the main question in the game. In this innovative approach to a bullet hell where the player must get shot to shoot back, and where the bullets shot are the music that is being played. In the game, you will be challenged throughout as the brutal difficulty will literally test your limits. Basically, if this ramble about my game is interesting at all just watch the stream as you get a look at the game as I answer any questions as I showcase my game.

Can YOU beat it?
